facts.fact: The guide recommends a streaming TV / CTV promo spot run 30 seconds.
facts.quote: Streaming TV / CTV spot | 30 seconds | Broad reach on connected TV via Adwave

facts.fact: The guide recommends a social teaser for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts run 6 to 15 seconds.
facts.quote: Social teaser (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) | 6-15 seconds

facts.fact: The guide recommends a standard social promo run 15 to 30 seconds.
facts.quote: Standard social promo | 15-30 seconds

facts.fact: The guide recommends a website hero or homepage promo run 30 to 60 seconds.
facts.quote: Website hero / homepage promo | 30-60 seconds

facts.fact: The guide recommends an event or product launch promo run 60 to 90 seconds.
facts.quote: Event or product launch promo | 60-90 seconds

facts.fact: The guide recommends a skippable YouTube pre-roll promo run 15 to 30 seconds, with the hook in the first 5 seconds.
facts.quote: YouTube pre-roll (skippable) | 15-30 seconds | Hook in first 5 seconds, YouTube advertising

facts.fact: The guide's rule of thumb is about 2.2 words of script per second of video, spoken at a natural pace.
facts.quote: about 2.2 words of script per second of video, spoken at a natural pace

facts.fact: By the guide's 2.2 words-per-second rule, a 30-second promo is roughly 65 to 75 words of script.
facts.quote: So a 30-second promo is roughly 65 to 75 words.

facts.fact: The guide says a viewer gives a promo about three seconds before they scroll past, so the hook must land in the first 3 seconds.
facts.quote: You have about three seconds before someone scrolls past.

facts.fact: The guide says Wavemaker's AI storyboard has 21 presets for setting the visual style.
facts.quote: it has 21 presets to set the visual style

facts.fact: The guide says the 30-second version of a promo should be made first because it fits the widest range of placements, including streaming TV.
facts.quote: make the 30-second version first. It fits the widest range of placements, including streaming TV

facts.fact: The guide describes a promo video as a short piece of video built to promote something specific, such as a product launch, event, sale, new location, or brand.
facts.quote: A promo video is a short piece of video built to promote something specific: a product launch, an event, a sale, a new location, or your brand as a whole.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, enough for a first video, exported at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 75 credits, which is enough for your first video, at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's paid plans remove the watermark and export up to 4K.
facts.quote: Paid plans remove the watermark and export up to 4K.

facts.fact: A roughly 30-second Wavemaker promo costs about 75 credits.
facts.quote: A ~30-second promo runs about 75 credits, a ~60-second version about 150, and each chat refine costs 15.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Starter plan costs $29 per month and includes 500 credits, exports up to 1080p, and has no watermark.
facts.quote: Starter is $29/mo (500 credits, up to 1080p, no watermark)

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Pro plan costs $99 per month and includes 2,000 credits, custom voice design, and API and MCP access.
facts.quote: Pro is $99/mo (2,000 credits, custom voice design, API and MCP access)

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Business plan costs $299 per month and includes 8,000 credits and exports up to 4K.
facts.quote: Business is $299/mo (8,000 credits, up to 4K)

facts.fact: Wavemaker credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 credits and never expire.
facts.quote: Credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 and never expire

facts.fact: Wavemaker exports vertical 9:16 cutdowns for Reels and Shorts and square 1:1 or 4:5 versions for social feeds.
facts.quote: Make a vertical (9:16) cutdown for Reels and Shorts and a square (1:1) or 4:5 version for feeds.

facts.fact: Adwave runs ads across 100+ premium streaming networks with local or national targeting, starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: It airs across 100+ premium streaming networks, with local or national targeting, starting at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that ad creation is free and campaigns launch in under 10 minutes.
facts.quote: Ad creation is free, campaigns launch in under 10 minutes

facts.fact: The page advises keeping the promo's hook in the first five seconds so it lands before the YouTube skip button.
facts.quote: Keep the hook in the first five seconds so it lands before the skip button.

facts.fact: The page says 15 to 30 seconds is the sweet spot for most promo videos, with 30 seconds the safest default.
facts.quote: For most uses, 15 to 30 seconds is the sweet spot, and 30 seconds is the safest default

facts.fact: The page says social teasers can run 6 to 15 seconds, while homepage brand promos and product launches can run 60 to 90 seconds.
facts.quote: Social teasers can run as short as 6 to 15 seconds, while homepage brand promos and product launches can stretch to 60 to 90 seconds

facts.fact: In the FAQ, Adwave's streaming TV spot for a 30-second promo is stated to start at $50, which conflicts with the $30 a day starting price given elsewhere on the page.
facts.quote: run it as a 30-second streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks via Adwave, starting at $50
